text:
jess: quick sync — we completed the soft launch last week and I want to prioritize what goes into the next 2-week iteration. three things surfaced from support/telemetry: 1) Console crash when saving route rules (seen by Acme), 2) embeddings truncated on long documents (repro on internal test + one customer), 3) inference timeouts in eu-west at peak. propose: immediate hotfix for anything customer-blocking (console crash?), backlog grooming to decide fixes vs enhancements tomorrow 11am PT. thoughts? @mike @anya @sam @ellie :eyes:

mike: quick notes from triage — console crash is likely a regression from recent validation change (PR #234) and looks small (missing null check). I can do a patch in <1 day. embeddings truncation is trickier — root cause seems tokenizer behaviour with long spans + our prefix caching; will need a model config change + retrain/compile step for the quantized variant, estimate 3-5 dev days + test. eu-west timeouts correlate with batch-size increase after autoscaler tweak; potentially config rollback buys time.

anya: Acme raised a support ticket and is blocked from saving new rules (they use route templates heavily). they flagged as "blocking" for their launch. if we can patch quickly that would avoid an escalation.

sam: +1 to patching the console crash first. for embeddings truncation — can we ship a mitigation (client-side truncate + user warning) while eng works on the model recompile? that's a product-friendly short-term workaround. for eu-west I prefer circuit-breaker or fallback model rather than rollback. fallback to smaller model kept the service usable in previous incidents.

ellie: telemetry dump: deploy-bot reported spike at 1719760000 UTC; error rate aligns with larger batch windows between 17:00-18:30 local. I can revert the autoscaler change for eu-west to previous policy (throttle batches to 8) which should reduce p95 latency. we can also enable per-route throttling for heavy embedding routes as temporary measure.

deploy-bot: [deploy-status] canary rollout completed 2024-11-22T14:02:00Z, recent rollback not detected.

jess: proposed immediate plan: 1) mike to cut console crash hotfix and ship canary today (owner: mike, ETA: EOD PT) 2) ellie to rollback/reconfigure autoscaler in eu-west to throttle batches (owner: ellie, ETA: 2h) 3) sam + product to draft customer-facing mitigation for embeddings (client-side truncate + help center note) and add to release notes (owner: sam, ETA: 24h) 4) eng to scope full model/compile fix and estimate work for sprint planning (owners: mike + eng-ml, ETA: prep doc by tomorrow meeting).

mike: ack. I'll open a small PR, add test, and request a quick canary. if anything blocks I'll ping.

ellie: rolling autoscaler change back now. will post metrics in #eng-infra in ~15m.

sam: drafting mitigation copy now, will post to #support-customer-commms and attach to the ticket. suggestion: offer priority patching for Acme if they need immediate SLA.

jess: agenda for tomorrow 11am PT grooming: - quick post-mortem of soft launch anomalies (5m) - decide hotfixes vs backlog items (15m) - scoping estimates for embeddings model work (20m) - customer comms and SLA offers (10m) - owners & deadlines (10m). please add anything else.

anya: can we add "risk of regressions from hotfix" to agenda? Acme asked for staging verification steps before we push to prod.

jess: good call. adding that and a checklist: staging repro, smoke tests, support verification.

mike: added a short repro snippet to the ticket: ```js
// minimal repro for console save crash
const req = await fetch('/api/routes', {method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({name: null, rules: [...]})})
// crash appears when name=null + rules.length>1
```

jess: thanks — everyone please confirm availability for 11am PT tomorrow. if you're not available, add a comment with your owner/ETA.

sam: available.

ellie: available.

mike: available after 10:30am PT.

jess: final action items recapped: - mike: hotfix canary (EOD) - ellie: autoscaler rollback eu-west (in-flight) - sam: customer mitigation & comms (24h) - eng-ml: scope model recompile (prep doc by tomorrow meeting) - support: verify Acme staging when hotfix is ready (anya). I'll post meeting invite and attach the triage notes. :thumbsup:

anya: will verify staging once hotfix is on canary and confirm to the thread.

jess: closing the loop — will reconvene during the grooming. thanks all. :heart:
